messages.text: Hi Jess, My name is Gagan and i am relocating from Melbourne to Gold Coast for work. I came across your advert for a housemate. I lived in Gold Coast priorly for 2.5 yrs. Now, i was looking for a place to rent near surfers. I am a clean and organised person and was looking for place that matches the same energy. Please do let me know if the place is still available for rent. If Yes, What would be the best time to come down for an inspection. Thanks!!!
Hi! We're doing inspections tonight at 7pm.
